name: Bao bdbSTBL empty-market exchange-rate inflation
summary: Bao's Compound-v2-fork CToken prices shares from its raw underlying balance and rounds down the shares burned by redeemUnderlying. In the empty bdbSTBL market the attacker kept 2 wei of bdbSTBL, donated 34.8M bSTBL to inflate their value, borrowed 41.3 baoETH from bdbaoETH, then redeemed the donation for almost no shares, leaving bad debt.
notes: bdbSTBL ages from the comptroller 0x8e8c327a setting its collateral factor to 0.75 (rule 8), which the borrow needed; it came after the market's creation, oracle feed and listing. The later IMF factor (0x0ec43235, block 16673654) only reduces borrowing power and the reserve factor only changes fees.
baoETH has no market price; it is valued at the 39.634 ETH the attacker realised for it in Balancer (rule 12). The market had no other exercise of the vulnerable path.
